name: Return Standing Order V 06
definition: Scope|The ReturnStandingOrder message is sent by a transaction administrator to a member.|It is used to provide information on the details of one or more standing orders, based on specific request and return criteria.|in response to a request a on information on standing and predefined orders.|Usage|The ReturnStandingOrder message lists the standing order based on the following possible return criteria: |- Generic standing order details,|- Details of a specific predefined or standing liquidity transfer orders,|- Details on the set to which the standing order belongs to,|- List of all predefined and standing liquidity transfer standing orders and/or per set,|- Total amount of predefined and standing liquidity transfer orders defined in the system.
